coupons.title: Flat 10% OFF on White Friday Deals
coupons.description: Valid on all White Friday selected items across categories. Minimum order AED 199. Maximum discount AED 200. Excludes already discounted items and limited‑time flash sales.
apply_guide: Step 1: Add eligible items worth at least AED 199 to the cart
Step 2: Enter code WFSAVINGS10 at checkout
Step 3: Verify that a 10% discount is applied before payment
coupons.terms: One‑time use per customer. Not applicable with other coupons or Prime Early Access deals.

coupons.title: Extra 10% OFF Daily Essentials
coupons.description: Additional 10% off on Daily Essentials (household, groceries & personal care) during White Friday. Minimum order AED 49. Max discount AED 150. Cannot be combined with other product‑specific offers.
apply_guide: Step 1: Add Daily Essentials items worth at least AED 49
Step 2: Apply code WHITEFRIDAY10 at checkout
Step 3: Confirm the extra 10% discount appears
coupons.terms: Valid only on White Friday (Nov 24‑30). Excludes gift cards and subscription services.

coupons.title: Up to 50% OFF on Shoes
coupons.description: Flat up to 50% discount on all shoes throughout the White Friday period. No minimum spend required. Discount applies to the highest‑priced eligible item in the cart.
apply_guide: Step 1: Add shoes to your cart
Step 2: Enter code WHITEFRIDAY50 at checkout
Step 3: Verify the discount is applied to the shoe(s) in the order
coupons.terms: Discount capped at 50% per shoe item. Not valid on limited‑stock or pre‑order items.

coupons.title: Free Delivery on Orders Over AED 150
coupons.description: Enjoy complimentary standard shipping on any order exceeding AED 150 during the White Friday sale. No coupon entry required; the benefit is applied automatically at checkout.
apply_guide: Step 1: Ensure your cart total is at least AED 150
Step 2: Proceed to checkout – free shipping will be applied automatically
Step 3: Review the shipping cost line to confirm it is zero
coupons.terms: Applies to standard delivery only. Express, Same‑Day, and international shipping fees are excluded.
